title: Quarterly Readout: Operational Playbook & Decision Anchors
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Produce an operational playbook and decision-anchors pack for the upcoming quarterly readout. Audience is execs, board members, and cross-functional leads. This ticket consolidates the narrative, escalation lanes, decision points (with recommended options), and the artifacts bundle (slides, one-pager, runbook appendix, risk heatmap). Scope: roadmap priorities, known execution risks, contingency lanes (rollforward/rollback), and asks (budget/people/infra). Excludes detailed technical runbooks for on-call (owned under ENG runbooks).
objectives: 1) Deliver a 12-slide executive deck with clear decision anchors; 2) Attach a two-page runbook describing escalation steps for the top three risks; 3) Produce a slide with cost/latency tradeoff scenarios and recommended choices; 4) Provide a single-page ask table (decision, owner, cost delta, timing)
acceptance_criteria: - Exec deck uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket; - One-pager asks table reviewed by CFO and Head of Product; - Risk heatmap validated with SRE and Security; - Walkthrough dry-run completed with cross-functional owners and feedback captured; - Decision log template created and accessible
progress_updates: 2026-02-14: Kickoff with SRE, Finance, and Eng leads. Agreed scope and top-3 risks (1: capacity contention on Dedicated, 2: KV cache regressions, 3: console telemetry gaps).
2026-02-20: Draft deck skeleton created. Liam to own decision anchors. Finance requested explicit cost delta table per option. Assigned to Sarah (Finance) for numbers.

2026-02-26: SRE validated mitigation ladders; recommended extra canary window for rollout A/B; added as contingency lane. Security requested a short statement on audit logging for Private customers — adding to appendix.
2026-03-05: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-10 with full leadership. Slide edits post-dry-run expected by 2026-03-12.
2026-03-12: Dry-run completed. Feedback: simplify tradeoff slide, add a single recommended path per decision anchor (with fallback). Action: update deck and produce final one-pager.
2026-03-12: Draft decision log template created and uploaded to Confluence.
decisions_and_rationale: Decision 1: Prioritize Dedicated capacity autoscaling improvements for Q2 launch. Rationale: highest customer SLA risk and clear ROI from committed contracts.

Decision 2: Defer aggressive KV cache quantization changes to runtime-1.23 to avoid regressions; apply targeted fixes for observed regressions instead. Rationale: avoid model-quality regressions during peak traffic.

Decision 3: Approve $120k one-time budget for observability retention extension for exec readout period (3 months). Rationale: needed to present reliable historical comparisons and root-cause analysis in QBR.
risks_and_mitigations: Top risks: capacity constraints on Dedicated (mitigation: enable burst pools + temporary customer throttles), KV cache regressions (mitigation: targeted fallback builds + extended canary), incomplete telemetry for console metrics (mitigation: enable short-term retention and manual instrumentation for key routes). Residual risk: moderate; acceptance after canary metrics meet SLO for 72h.
feedback_and_review_notes: Finance (2026-03-02): Requested per-option cost deltas and a worst-case spend scenario.
SRE (2026-03-04): Asked for a measurable canary success criterion and rollback thresholds.
Security (2026-03-06): Requested a brief audit-logging statement for Private customers; added to appendix.
Design (2026-03-08): Suggested tightening the visuals on the tradeoff slide for faster comprehension at the board level.
next_steps: Finalize deck edits after dry-run (owner: Liam) — due 2026-03-14
Get CFO sign-off on asks table (owner: Sarah) — due 2026-03-15
Attach final runbook appendix and decision log to Confluence (owner: Dev) — due 2026-03-16
Prep brief talking points and rehearse with CEO/Head of Product (owner: Priya) — due 2026-03-17
notes_for_presentation: Open with 3 slides: 1) 'What changed since last quarter' (metrics-backed), 2) 'Top risks & mitigation', 3) 'Decisions we need today'. Keep asks explicit and binary where possible. For each decision anchor, include recommended choice, alternatives, financial impact, and rollback plan.
postmortem_and_followup_plan: If any decision is taken with high residual risk, schedule a follow-up postmortem within 30 days. Owner of postmortem will be the decision owner. Capture lessons into the playbook and update runbook appendix.
distribution_plan: After finalization: email exec pack to board + execs, upload deck to Confluence, create a short Loom walkthrough for internal teams, and publish a condensed one-pager to the company-wide newsletter.
company_context: This pack frames the Q2 asks that tie directly to Dedicated capacity commitments and the roadmap cadence for runtime improvements. Aligns with the thesis of predictable inference economics — the primary message for execs and board.
final_comment: This ticket is the canonical source for the Q2 readout artifacts. If you update slides or the asks table, add a link and brief note here so the audit trail remains intact.
